'''''The High Republic: Into the Light''''' is a ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' young-adult novel by [[Claudia Gray]]. The book was published as part of Phase III of the multimedia project on [[April 1]], [[2025]]. An [[The High Republic: Into the Light (audiobook)|audiobook]] narrated by [[Amber Lee Connors]] was released on [[April 15]], [[2025]].
